units.source_text: 从川奈回来之后，这盘棋的纠纷又继续发展下去。

en.t: After returning from Kawana, the dispute over this game continued to develop.

units.source_text: 我只不过是旁观者，最后连我也当了本因坊名人和大竹七段之间的斡旋人。

en.t: I was only a bystander, yet in the end even I became a mediator between the Honinbo Meijin and Otake 7-dan.

units.source_text: 这盘棋好歹又于十一月二十五日继续下去了。

en.t: At any rate, the game was resumed on November 25.
